🔑 Angle facts

Ask first, then click for each one.

📐 Acute

An acute angle is ?

LESS than 90°

∟ Right angle

A right angle is ?

exactly 90°

📐 Obtuse

An obtuse angle is ?

between 90° and 180°

🔄 Reflex

A reflex angle is ?

MORE than 180°

⭕ Full turn

A full turn is ?

360°

Guess the type FIRST. Then measure. Does it match?

🏠 Menu

🎮 Gaming chair recline

Your gaming chair reclines. How far back is too far? 😴

Measure the recline angle. Is it acute, obtuse or reflex?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Is it more than a right angle?

Yes: more than 90°

Step 2

Put the protractor on

135°

Step 3

Between 90° and 180°

OBTUSE

135°: obtuse (comfy, not asleep! 😂)

🏠 Menu

🔍 Spot the mistake

Is the student right? Find the mistake. Chat first, then click!

1

Kai says: "The angle is 140°."

✗ He read the wrong scale.

✓ It is acute, so 40°.

2

Lia says: "It is 100°, so it is acute."

✗ 100° is NOT acute.

✓ Between 90° and 180°: obtuse.

3

Mo says: "The inside is 60°, so reflex r = 180 − 60 = 120°."

✗ Used 180, not 360.

✓ r = 360 − 60 = 300°.

Guess the type first. Read the scale that starts at 0.

🔑 Compass facts

🧭 Clockwise

Going clockwise from north: N, ?

N, E, S, W

NE (north-east)

A quarter turn is ?

180°

🔁 Three-quarter turn

A three-quarter turn is ?

270°

Never Eat Shredded Wheat: N, E, S, W.

🏠 Menu

🚗 Sat nav fail

You face north. The sat nav says "turn right" ... then "turn right" again.

Which way are you facing now?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Turn right = 90° clockwise

N → E

Step 2

Turn right again

E → S

Step 3

90° + 90°

180°: a half turn

SOUTH: you are going backwards! 😂

⚖️ Turn court: guilty or not guilty?

Is the claim right? Vote with your team, then click for the verdict!

1

"Turning 270° clockwise ends in the same place as 90° anticlockwise."

✓ NOT GUILTY

True: both end facing west.

2

"Face north. A half turn makes you face east."

✗ GUILTY

A half turn is 180°: south.

3

"North-east is halfway between north and east."

✓ NOT GUILTY

True: 45° from each.

Draw the turn on the compass before you vote.

A robot starts facing north. 1 square = 10 cm. It moves 30 cm to A. It turns to a bearing of 090° and moves 50 cm to B. It turns to a bearing of 180° and moves 30 cm to C. How far is C from the start, and on what bearing?

Squares: 3 up, 5 right, 3 down.

Answer: 50 cm on a bearing of 090°
